notable: 截至2026年7月31日的季度转亏为盈，净利304万令吉。

risks: 董事Choy Mui Seng于2026年8月24日出售16,650,000股（2.441%）。

recent_en: Hartanah Kenyalang swung back to profit in the quarter ended 31 July 2026 with net income of RM3.04 million, while revenue rose 64.6% year-on-year. In the same period, the company changed its financial year end, and a director disposed of shares while Solarvest Holdings Berhad acquired shares.
notable_en: Swung back to profit in the quarter ended 31 July 2026 with net income of RM3.04 million.
The company changed its financial year end.
Director Choy Mui Seng disposed of 16,650,000 shares (2.441%) on 24 August 2026, while Solarvest Holdings Berhad acquired the same number of shares via direct business transaction on the same day.
risks_en: Director Choy Mui Seng disposed of 16,650,000 shares (2.441%) on 24 August 2026.
earnings_en: For 3Q FY2026 (ended 31 July), revenue was RM49.537 million, up 11.5% QoQ and 64.6% YoY; net income was RM3.04 million, up 49.1% QoQ and 126.5% YoY; net margin improved from 4.6% to 6.1%.
